execution_policy_rules: 1. Every terminal generation artifact is persisted immediately
2. Existing terminal observations are reused and never regenerated
3. Benchmark-wrong outputs are terminal scientific observations
4. Malformed Mind2Web generation is terminal fail-closed scientific output when provider generation completed (correct=false, parse_status=NO_JSON)
5. Provider quota/rate-limit exhaustion is infrastructure state, NOT scientific failure
6. Daily/free-allocation exhaustion causes: checkpoint, flush ledger, graceful process stop
12. Future resume begins only from stable missing task IDs
13. Already terminal artifacts must pass structural/hash validation before being skipped
14. AgentDojo runs to natural upstream termination, with the 48-call outer runaway fuse only
15. Attempted AgentDojo call 49: STOP case/run with explicit infrastructure blocker
16. Bounded transient transport retry behavior may use only the already authorized provider-client retry contract
17. A daily quota/allocation error must NOT be hidden by arbitrary retries
